About Marutokk丸登靴下工業について

A long-term partner for custom socks.オリジナル靴下の、長期的なパートナー。

MARUTOKK / 丸登靴下工業株式会社 is a Japanese socks manufacturer founded in 1934. The company presents custom socks, wholesale production and support for brands looking to develop their own products.

From idea to finished socksアイデアから完成品まで

Share your design or idea. Our team can support sample development, changes and production so your concept becomes a finished product.

Our promise:私たちの約束： quality, individual attention and practical production support.
